system.description:
15th Level Clan Feature

You can control the smoke your body and jutsu produces to such a degree, that you can even cause it to coat the lungs of your foes, choking them from the inside.

As an Action, you must select a point you can see within 60 feet of you, or as a reaction select a cloud, gas, mist or fog that you are in control of.

If you spend an action selecting a point, you generate a 20-foot radius cloud of black smoke, centered on the chosen point, for the next minute. If you spent your reaction selecting a cloud, gas, mis or fog that you control, your transform it into a cloud of thick black smoke, but in the same shape.

Creatures of your choice that are inside or entering the cloud treat the area as obscured and difficult terrain. Yourself and allies you can see are not hindered by your own cloud. Creatures of your choice who begin or end their turn in the cloud or enter it for the first time on a turn, must make a Constitution saving throw vs your highest jutsu save DC. On a failed save, they gain a rank of Exhaustion, as they begin hacking and wheezing, finding it difficult to breathe.

As a bonus action on subsequent turns, you can move the select point, up to 30 feet into a space you can see. This Cloud can be suspended midair and does not need to settle on the ground.

Creatures that gained ranks of Exhaustion as a result of this feature, that spend at least 1 minute outside of this cloud, loses all ranks of the inflicted Exhaustion.

Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a rest.
